correctness.rationale: For u≠0 shift T by v/u and count squarefree quartics by inclusion/exclusion. Distinct repeated rational roots of f and f+uT give four Hermite constraints, one monic quartic per ordered pair (alpha,beta), q(q-1) incidences. Multiple rational repeated roots occur only for squares H^2 of split quadratics, while irreducible H^2 contributes an uncounted nonsquarefree case. The parametrization by s=H(beta)≠0 yields discriminant (u^2-16s^3)/(4s^2), and the two directions give -2 sum chi, without overlap because H^2-K^2=uT is impossible in odd characteristic. Adding s=0 yields C=C0-2S_q(u). If gcd(3,q-1)=1, cubing permutes F_q so S=0, including characteristic 3. Otherwise cubic-character and quadratic-character orthogonality gives mean S=0 and mean S²=2q from |Jacobi sum|²=q, hence variance 8q. Independent direct polynomial-gcd enumeration for all nonzero slopes at q=3,5,7 gave 162+2500+14406=17068 quartic pairs and slope variance 0,0,56 respectively. Finite checks are not proof for all q.
